programme.title: Rustum

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga

programme.title: Monarch of the Glen
programme.desc: Young restaurateur Archie McDonald is tricked into returning to Glenbogle by his eccentric parents, Hector and Molly, and finds the estate is on the verge of bankruptcy. (S1 Ep1)

programme.title: Monarch of the Glen
programme.desc: A ruthless banker informs the family that if they can't pay the outstanding debt, the bank will close Glenbogle. Desperate to save his home, Archie pulls out all the stops. (S1 Ep2)

programme.title: Monarch of the Glen
programme.desc: Archie's girlfriend and business partner, Justine, has arrived from London to find out what he is up to while Killwillie asks the family to host the Glenbogle ball in his place. (S1 Ep3)

programme.title: Monarch of the Glen
programme.desc: A genealogist comes to Glenbogle looking for the rightful heir to the Ballantine clan. Meanwhile, he reveals a secret tie between the MacDonald family and Katrina. (S1 Ep4)

programme.title: Monarch of the Glen
programme.desc: Archie's sister Lizzie turns up with her boyfriend and a group of massage therapists intent on turning Glenbogle into a healing centre, meanwhile Golly goes missing. (S1 Ep5)

programme.title: Little House On The Prairie
programme.desc: A Faraway Cry: Caroline travels to an influenza-ridden mining camp with Dr Baker after she receives a plea for help from an old friend who is pregnant and desperately ill. (S8 Ep20)

programme.title: Little House On The Prairie
programme.desc: He Was Only Twelve: Part 1: During a trip to Sleepy Eye, James and Albert walk into a bank robbery. James is critically wounded, and the doctor tells James is expected to die. Part 1 of 2. (S8 Ep21)

programme.title: Little House On The Prairie
programme.desc: He Was Only Twelve: Part 2: Charles, unable to deal with the mounting pressure concerning his son's critical condition, becomes verbally abusive to his family and friends. Part 2 of 2. (S8 Ep22)

programme.title: Little House On The Prairie

programme.title: Little House On The Prairie

programme.title: Little House On The Prairie

programme.title: Little House On The Prairie
programme.desc: Rage: Mr Stark is denied a bank loan; this sends him over the edge, and he shoots his wife and daughter. He hides in Laura's house, convinced that she and Jenny are his wife and daughter. (S9 Ep4)

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Love and Marriage: Frank blames a young Korean assistant, Mr Kwan, for his mistakes in the OR. Hawkeye and Trapper befriend Kwan and try to reunite him with his pregnant wife. (S3 Ep20)

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Big Mac: The camp prepares for a visit from General Douglas MacArthur, but not all personnel are excited; Klinger, in his drag, is told to keep out of sight. (S3 Ep21)
